description:
`ContainerDestinationState` has six variants for three outcomes. Classification facts default silently when location evidence is missing, so an uninspected location reads as a value instead of an error.

## Background

`ContainerDestinationState` (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_classifier.rs:243-257`) has one consumer, `append_container_destination_blocker` (`:1602-1628`). It maps `Absent`, `OwnedByTarget` and `MarkerlessAccounted` to no blocker; `OwnedByOther(_)` and `MarkerlessWithUnaccountedEntries` to `DestinationConflict`; and `Symlink` to `SymlinkArtifact`. The `String` in `OwnedByOther` is never read. Constructors: `:549` (`_ => Absent`) and `:586-628` (`container_destination_from_evidence`).

`ArtifactLocation` derives `Default` with `#[default] Unknown` (`:193-197`: "The caller did not inspect this path. Production planners should avoid this state"). `ArtifactLocationFacts`, `ContainerDestinationState` and `ArtifactClassificationFacts` also derive `Default`. Production default sites: `:966` (`locations.get(&source).cloned().unwrap_or_default()`), `:536-539` and `:549`. No code matches `ArtifactLocation::Unknown` explicitly.

`ArtifactEvidenceError::IncompleteEvidence { path }` (`:410-420`) is the typed evidence error, produced by `required_resolution_evidence` (`:495-503`). An anyhow twin, `required_evidence` (`:631-639`), serves `classification_facts_from_evidence` (`:519`). `classify_artifacts` returns `PlanError` (`domain/artifact_plan.rs:1115`). The storage side builds the evidence map (`storage/artifact_planning.rs:82-145`).

Test sites: `artifact_classifier.rs:2612,2616,2957,3944,3991,4076-4212,4672`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ContainerDestinationState` has one variant per outcome it produces, with no unread payload.
- [hard] REQ-02: `ArtifactLocation` has no unknown or uninspected variant, and the classification facts types derive no `Default`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Classifying an artifact whose location was never inspected fails with `ArtifactEvidenceError::IncompleteEvidence` naming the path, and no anyhow evidence twin remains.
- [hard] REQ-04: `classify_artifacts` surfaces the evidence error through its own error type.
- [hard] REQ-05: Classifier unit tests cover each outcome and the missing-evidence error.

## Notes

The archive's short-id destination fallback (`artifact_classifier.rs:417-431`) is out of scope.
title: Collapse container-destination classification to its outcomes
